source_report.title: From alert to agency: What turns warnings into action?

georgia.interpretation: Below the report's n>=100 respondents-asked threshold; not a sufficiently sized country estimate for ranking or operational planning.

source_report_reproduction.note: These are the source repository's published reproduction results; NOEMA has not independently rerun the 143,459-row microdata.

methodology_notes: Warning-channel questions were asked of impacted respondents who named a disaster type; 24,249 respondents formed this base.
Ability-to-act was asked only of warned respondents (16,996).
The warning-channel count treats don't-know, refused and not-applicable as no, following the source report's reproduction README.

The 22.8% Georgia figure is reported in the source methodology note only under an alternative threshold of at least 100 impacted respondents; Georgia had 99 respondents asked about warnings and is excluded under the report's n>=100 asked threshold.
Associations between channel count, preparedness and ability to act do not establish causal effects.
